top.text: Coming home from a big social weekend to a cozy game sounds like the right recharge. Quality-of-life updates make such a difference in these slow games. Enjoy the progress!

For short pick-up-and-put-down sessions, the Standard farm is the easiest one: lots of open space and no awkward shapes to plan around. If you want something pretty and relaxed, the Forest farm is a nice pick too.
Stardew Valley's fishing is a gentle one: you keep the bar on the fish and the pace stays calm, which makes a nice break between busier games.

Dinkum is worth a look: you build up a small town and explore a big open world at your own pace, with no pressure to rush. Palia also has a lot of free-form building if you want something with a bit more community feel.
Nothing wrong with that at all. Unpacking is a good fit for a stressful day: no timer, no fail state, just calm little tasks.
